method: Explicit ERA5-Land 0.1-degree model-grid cells selected when the nearest centroid cell contains the official >=10 m glacier snow-depth indicator. Overrides remain representative hiking-corridor points, not whole-region averages.

zermatt.label: western Zermatt hiking cell
zermatt.reason: The nearest eastern cell is a permanent glacier-indicator cell. The adjacent western cell is equally close to the destination coordinate, remains within the Zermatt hiking area and has zero glacier-indicator hours in retained source evidence.

grindelwald.label: western Grindelwald hiking cell
grindelwald.reason: The nearest centroid cell intermittently crosses the official glacier indicator. The adjacent western hiking cell has zero glacier-indicator hours in retained source evidence and a 2062 m model elevation.

annapurna.label: southern Annapurna trekking-corridor cell
annapurna.reason: The massif-centroid cell is a permanent glacier-indicator cell. This cell represents the established southern trekking corridor at a 4296 m model elevation rather than glacier terrain.

everest-region.label: lower Khumbu trekking-corridor cell
everest-region.reason: The massif-centroid cell is a permanent glacier-indicator cell. This lower Khumbu cell represents the approach trekking corridor at a 3864 m model elevation rather than the summit/glacier grid cell.

torres-del-paine.label: eastern Torres del Paine trail-sector cell
torres-del-paine.reason: The western centroid cell is a permanent ice-field indicator cell. This adjacent low-alpine trail-sector cell represents the main hiking area at a 550 m model elevation.
